text: Still not yet. Look close. You have 6 squares and a bunch of open space on a single cube. blockbench has one mesh that fills the entier uv space [Image #84] [Image #85]
resolution: The UV-layout slice, with a key conceptual correction from the user: the UV MESH is NOT the texture. (1) The UV mesh (the mapping the UV editor shows): a base cube maps EVERY face to the FULL unit square — clicking any face shows the whole 16x16 outline because every face samples the entire texture. New fullFaceUV(m) in editMesh.ts (each face's own projection normalized to fill [0,1]^2) is now the default; cuboid()/cylinder() call it. (2) The texture (the box-net colored regions, Blockbench image 89): a downstream artifact created by 'create texture' that packs faces into atlas regions AND remaps their UVs — that is unwrap() (the box-net packer, kept) and is Phase 5c, not the default. So req_1002 (box-net) and req_1003 (fill the square) were both this confusion and now belong to 5c; the panel's button became 'Reset UV' (fullFaceUV) instead of Unwrap. editMesh 25/25 (the fresh-cuboid test now asserts every face fills the full unit square; the box-net contiguity test now calls unwrap() explicitly). Hot-reload TSX, nothing committed. Superseded/folded into the req_1004 correction: the box-net is the create-texture step (5c), not the default UV mesh.
